mentions.name: TreeSeek
mentions.description: A web app that instantly geolocates the user and shows the nearest trees to them, built to identify a particular tree encountered while walking as quickly as possible, with more confidence and speed than tools like iNaturalist.
mentions.problem: Existing tree identification tools like iNaturalist are slower and less confident for quickly identifying a particular tree spotted while walking.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been working on https://treeseek.ca which is a different use case from most of the other open data tree sites I’ve seen — I want to be instantly geolocated and shown the nearest trees to me.
